title: Preface: church rule before inquiry (Rufinus)
english: All who believe and are sure that [[grace and truth came through Jesus Christ >> Bible:John 1:17]], and who know Christ to be the truth as he said [[I am the truth >> Bible:John 14:6]], receive the knowledge that calls people to live well and blessedly not from any source but from Christ’s words and teaching. Many who profess Christ disagree even on the greatest things — God, the Lord Jesus Christ, the Holy Spirit, and the other creatures — so we must first set a clear line and open rule on each, then inquire further. Use these as [[elements and foundations >> Bible:Hebrews 5:12]], according to the command [[light for yourselves the light of knowledge >> Bible:Hosea 10:12]], to build one body of teaching from the holy Scriptures and from what follows by right consequence.

added_allusions.reason: grace and truth through Jesus Christ

translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 22 (1913) Rufinus Latin OCR; disclose Rufinus paraphrase.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; no ANF Crombie / Butterworth.

title: God is not a body: fire, spirit, light
english: I know some will try from our Scriptures to say God is a body, finding in Moses [[our God is a consuming fire >> Bible:Deuteronomy 4:24]] and in John [[God is spirit >> Bible:John 4:24]]. Fire and spirit they take as nothing but body. Ask them what they say of [[God is light, and in him is no darkness >> Bible:1 John 1:5]]. That light is what illumines every mind that can receive truth, as the psalm says [[in your light we see light >> Bible:Psalm 36:9]] — that is, in your Word and Wisdom, your Son, we see you the Father. The name “light” does not make him like this sun’s bodily light.

added_allusions.reason: in your light we see light
